policy: On 2026-10-11 the owner expressly authorized promoting the current 2026.10.11.3 learner UI to the hosted non-production /preview/ path via PR #603, conditional on protected-main CI and production HOLD. Independent real devices, 200% zoom, NVDA/VoiceOver, Book/curriculum SME, learner studies, NZQA/provider G1-G8, Windows signing, production/root and machine-control authority remain HOLD.
